requirement.original: The MCP tool mcp__happy__change_title fails after server restarts. This was previously fixed (Bug #62) but the fix doesn't persist across restarts.
requirement.clarified: The STDIO MCP bridge that provides the change_title tool silently fails on restart due to monorepo dependency resolution fragility (ajv@6 vs ajv@8). The fix must ensure the bridge startup is verified, failures are logged, and the ajv dependency pinning survives yarn install cycles.
requirement.what: Make mcp__happy__change_title MCP tool resilient to daemon/session restarts
requirement.why: Session titles never update after daemon restart, degrading user experience with no visible error

included: STDIO bridge startup validation and error reporting
HTTP MCP server health check before passing URL to Claude
Daemon log visibility for MCP bridge status
excluded: Changing MCP SDK version or transport protocol
Alternative title change mechanisms bypassing MCP

success_criteria: change_title works after daemon restart without manual intervention
Bridge failures are logged visibly in daemon logs
ajv@8 resolves correctly from happy-cli after yarn install at workspace root
constraints: Must not change Claude SDK integration interface
Must not modify production daemon (default/jade) behavior
STDIO bridge is required by Claude SDK's mcpServers config format

root_cause_analysis.symptom: mcp__happy__change_title tool unavailable after daemon restart; Claude proceeds without the tool, no error shown to user
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The STDIO bridge process (happyMcpStdioBridge.mjs) silently crashes on startup when ajv@6 from workspace root is resolved instead of ajv@8 from happy-cli's own node_modules. Claude SDK marks the MCP server as 'failed' but surfaces no user-visible error. The ajv@8 pinning in package.json can be overridden by yarn's hoisting algorithm during subsequent yarn install cycles. Additionally, there is NO startup verification: runClaude() blindly passes the HTTP MCP server URL to mcpServers config without confirming the bridge can actually start.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Bug #62 fix commits: ccffa5a1, 00c760cc — fixes are correct but fragile
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: MCP bridge architecture requires a separate STDIO process that resolves its own node_modules. In a monorepo with Expo (ajv@6) and MCP SDK (ajv@8), Node.js ESM resolution walks up to workspace root and finds the wrong version.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The fix (adding ajv@8 to package.json) depends on yarn's hoisting decisions remaining stable. Any yarn install at workspace root can change hoisting. The bridge crash is completely silent — Claude SDK only sets internal status to 'failed'.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Bug #15 (2026-03-21) fixed metadata chain. Bug #62 (2026-04-05) fixed bridge crash + transport reuse. Recurrence happens on every daemon restart where node_modules state has drifted.
